quest.title: Missive of Cloud and Fog
quest.description: As Venti's all-important assistant, you are to go out with him to collect the love poetry written by the people of Mondstadt. However, the citizenry has various troubles of their own, even during such a festive time as this.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius' headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Venti might be here already, let's take a look inside!

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: Halt! Citizens, what noble errand brings you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is Kaeya here? We need him for something.

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: Captain Kaeya? He's on duty in Jean's office.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Why is he in Jean's office?

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: The Windblume Festival celebrations have always been hosted by the Knights of Favonius. During the festivities, Master Jean personally goes out on patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: Captain Kaeya takes over her administrative duties during that period.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, is that right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hiya!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I was just thinking about you two, and now here you are. How fortuitous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya, did you do your homework?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I must disappoint you... I haven't even started writing it yet.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm, students that don't hand in their homework on time aren't exactly model students now, are they?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what excuse does Kaeya have for not handing in his homework?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well, as you can see, I'm helping Master Jean take care of various matters.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Mondstadt is a hive of activity over the festive period. Accordingly, there's a multitude of things that need sorting. *sigh* I've been at it for a good while now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Traveler... can I ask for a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I have a drinking buddy that wants me to help him with something, but I'm much too busy. Can I entrust this matter to you?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: A drinking buddy? A friend you met at the tavern?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: That's right. I often go to the tavern when not on duty. Somehow, I seem to have made quite a few acquaintances that way.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: His name is Nimrod, he's never far from the tavern. He should be free right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Thanks for the help. I'd better stay behind and get started on my homework.

choices.text: I'll consider it part of my Windblume experience.

talks.objective: Go look for Nimrod at the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: *sigh* What should I do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You must be Nimrod! Kaeya mentioned there was something you wanted him to take care of. He's busy right now, but we can help.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Oh, Traveler... I didn't realize it was you.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...It's like this: I'm planning to give a gift to my wife for the Windblume Festival, and I wanted my drinking buddy, Kaeya, to come up with a gift idea.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...I—I'm afraid I'm a bit of a drunkard, I'm nearly always in the tavern. My wife hates me drinking, so we're constantly arguing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Another day, another drunkard...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I can empathize, I don't mind a drink or two myself! Then again, and I'm not one to judge, but by the looks of your drinking habits... hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I know... She's right, of course. I feel like I have to make it up to her.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...Traveler, can you help me gather some materials? I want to make a gift for her myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...I should have made preparations in advance, but I've barely been sober these last few days. I fell asleep, and when I woke up the celebrations had already begun! Now I'll never have time to finish it by myself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeesh, this guy is a mess...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ...Single folks in Mondstadt would never dare get others to help them during the festive period. It's lucky you're already married, Nimrod.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Uh-huh... you're telling me... *sigh* I'm sorry... Here I am making a fool of myself in front of all of you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* What's done is done. Spit it out then, how can we help?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I'm going to look for wood in the city, and we'll need plants to place inside. Those only grow in the wild, could I ask you to retrieve them? I need two stems of Small Lamp Grass.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Small Lamp Grass and wood... what are you making, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I want to make her a little wooden house, with glowing flowers and handmade furniture inside...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Aww, such a thoughtful gift!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: A token of my love, haha. ...Back when I'd only just gotten to know her, I used to make handmade gifts for her all the time... She loved them, she even used to say that...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Oh! Uh — ahem, excuse me. Let's put the past aside for the moment. Thank you all for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lucky you came across such kind-hearted assistants, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go and find those materials!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...I haven't done any carpentry for a long time now. I hope everything goes to plan!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...Thank you, thank you so much! With these materials, I can get to work straight away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Remember, a gift can't solve everything! You need to start being fair to your wife, too!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I will, I will!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: *sigh* I do hope she likes my gift, though...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Everyone likes a gift given with love, don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Make it a good one! Don't go wasting those materials, they weren't easy to find y'know!

talks.objective: Go back to the Knights' headquarters and report to Kaeya

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Kaeya, have you finished?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Time to hand in your homework!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Welcome back, I'm just finishing up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go, go, go, hand it in, hand it in!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... Now then, no hurting my feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm... Mm? Ooooh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard, what grade did he get?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Kaeya, may I read this out loud?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Feel free.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: *clears throat*

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: "Mi muhe ye\nMeans I love you\nIn the language of the hilichurls."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Ehh!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's it!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Coherent and to the point. Plus, the length seems about right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? Are you writing a Hilichurlian phrase book!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha, a love poem has to convey the style of its author, you know?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I'm not sure you took the exercise seriously.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... so we're just gonna gloss over the fact that Kaeya can speak Hilichurlian? Weird.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha, don't underestimate the hidden knowledge of the Knights of Favonius' Cavalry Captain!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Alright then, time to collect the next student's homework...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I just caught sight of a suspicious figure, I must go and investigate. Traveler, I have another small task for you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The Church has applied to us for a hunting license. Please take these official documents to the Cathedral.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Running errands again...!

choices.text: Nice work, you learned a lot, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Lisa, we need to establish some ground rules... If we do end up apprehending any drunken troublemakers, no electrocutions. Okay?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh Jean, you misunderstand me. That intoxicated fellow you witnessed last time was practically begging me to be shocked. It makes me wonder if some people don't actually quite enjoy getting—

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Lisa!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Very well then, if you insist.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jean, Lisa!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Greetings, ladies! It's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: A while indeed. As you can see, Lisa and I are on duty.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Aww, it's cutie and friends. Did you see any suspicious people on the way here? If you do see anything, report straight to the Knights.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since when do librarians go out on patrol?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Rarely, but this is the Windblume Festival, and they need all hands on deck. Even the humble clerical staff, like me.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Lisa, "humble clerical staff" do not wield Electro the way you do.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* Please do not be alarmed, I will keep my eyes on Lisa. Especially since she seems to enjoy electrocuting people just to break up a scuffle. Not to mention shocking drunkards until they beg for mercy...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: If you don't like it, I can happily refrain.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Is that a promise? Good. Otherwise, I'm going to have to reconsider whether I want a librarian on patrol with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon never knew being on patrol could be so exciting!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Barbara, Kaeya sent us to deliver the—

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: How dare they! This is sheer intimidation!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: How could somebody do this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What's happened?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I... *sniff* I—I received a letter... *sniff* It says... I—It says...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Let me. I just came back from the wilderness. As usual, I came by the Cathedral to ask the sisters to patch me up. That's when I saw Barbara running out, white as a sheet. She was holding a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I've never received a letter like this before...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Can I take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hm... "Dear Barbara, I've stolen the thing most precious to you and buried it." Huh... Could this be an attempt at intimidation?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's awful... is it a joke? If so, we don't need to worry. But...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...But... what if it's real...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a map on the back, isn't that out in the wilderness?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hmm... the thing most precious to you...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hm, buried...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Huh... that location on the map is familiar, I've definitely been there before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what is the thing most precious to you?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I can't think straight right now, nothing makes sense... *whimpers*

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's coming to me... It's coming to me...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: The thing most precious to me... W—Wait, could it be? Oh no!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Barbara! Hey! Slow down!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Aha! I've got it! The Thousand Winds Temple!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Bennett — hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are they in such a hurry? Let's catch up with them!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...My sister!

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Slow down.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Rosaria! I just—

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Calm down.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I ran into Jean a moment ago, Lisa was with her. She's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: *gasp* R—Really? A—Are you sure?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Whew...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: That letter. Give it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Sure...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...If they're not talking about Jean in the letter... then what are they talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you really think they'd buried Jean underground!? What a horrible thought!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: So, Sister, have you found any leads?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Looking at the map, the perpetrator seems to have marked out an area around Dawn Winery.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: That's open land, so hiding something there... Hmm, what could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice work! How did you figure that out so quickly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Although... Dawn Winery? That's not the place we were thinking...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Barbara, rather than letting your imagination get the better of you, stand up and face this head-on.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...You're right, it's just...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's a little scary, right? That's why we're going with you. What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Uh? Th—That's very kind...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And you, Sister? Will you be accompanying us?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: No need... I knew straight away there was nothing to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? And what does that mean?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: ...Nothing. Get going, then.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Barbara, are you feeling a bit better now?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! I'm... I'm okay.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Rosaria is right, better to know the ways of the enemy than stand here scaring myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! Let's get moving!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Thank you, all of you. Let's get to the location and see what we find.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, yup! Go, Barbara, go!

talks.objective: Go to the location marked out on the map

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this? Hmm... quick, let's open it!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ...Interesting... such an exquisite gift box. What's it doing out here in the wilderness?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, what a beautiful Windwheel Aster wreath! And so many paper stars!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hmm... looks like our "perpetrator" is really just one of Barbara's fans.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's a note! What does it say? Hmm, let's see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "So sorry to get your attention this way. Please accept this Windblume as a sign of my sincere admiration for your virtue and sweetness."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So it's... fraudulent intimidation, then?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Be it for the gods or that special someone, flowers should be offered in utmost sincerity. It's the most important ceremony of the Windblume Festival.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Flowers of love and blessings, sent on such a special occasion... No effort should be spared to make it spectacular.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Behind the questionable methodology... here we have a meticulously thought-out and heartfelt gift.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh... laying it on a little thick, aren't we...? Still seems like someone with a few screws loose to Paimon...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hahaha, maybe you're right. I think I have a suspect in mind who fits that description...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who? Who?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I think I know the answer too.)

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Shh! No telling, now... I'd like Paimon to make a few guesses.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah!? You're so annoying!

choices.text: Is this just someone's way of getting your attention?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Feel free to take your time... I need to channel my inner poet.
